programme.title: Uncharted Amazon S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Peru, seekor anteater sutra (silky anteater) berjuang untuk tetap terjaga, sementara seekor burung kolibri betina berusaha keras membesarkan anaknya. Selama jutaan tahun evolusi, mereka telah mengembangkan hubungan-hubungan yang unik dan strategi-strategi tak terduga untuk mengatasi perubahan kondisi lingkungan yang terus berlangsung. Namun, dengan segala kecerdikan yang mereka miliki, mereka tidak pernah siap menghadapi kedatangan spesies baru yang muncul di habitat mereka.

programme.title: Changing Planet: Coral Special
programme.desc: Peter dan timnya mengumpulkan ribuan sel telur (sel reproduksi) dari karang, yang dapat menentukan nasib terumbu karang tersebut. Dalam proses IVF ini, tujuan mereka adalah meningkatkan peluang reproduksi dan pembuahan.

programme.title: Engineering Repurposed, Ep 10
programme.desc: Struktur, bangunan, dan mesin yang luar biasa di seluruh dunia telah diubah dari fungsi aslinya menjadi sesuatu yang benar-benar berbeda. Para ahli menjelaskan bagaimana hal itu terjadi.

programme.desc: Yu, murid sang Guru Besar, dan Chiao Chiao, putri dari musuh bebuyutannya, berada dalam masalah saat mereka jatuh cinta. Hal ini diperparah ketika Chiao Chiao membunuh seorang pria di klan Yu.

programme.title: Dream Of The Red Chamber
programme.desc: Pao-yu jatuh cinta pada sepupunya, Lin Tai-yu, tetapi keluarganya memiliki rencana pernikahan lain untuknya yang akan membuat keduanya patah hati.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Saat merencanakan pembalasan terhadap Huan yang kejam, istri Shen Lang mengacaukan konferensi dan harus diantar pulang. Dalam perjalanan pulang, mereka terjebak dalam perangkap Huan yang mematikan.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Penipu cantik bernama Hua mencuri sebuah cincin berlian dari toko di Hong Kong dan kabur ke Singapura. Untuk menghindari bea cukai, ia memasukkan cincin itu ke dalam saku pria asing, tapi ia kehilangan jejaknya.

programme.title: That Man In Chang-An
programme.desc: Kaisar Han meninggal dan Permaisuri Lu merebut alih kekuasaan. Ia merencanakan untuk membunuh pewaris takhta, Liu Heng. Namun, prajurit bertopeng mengetahui rencana jahatnya dan memberi tahu Liu.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: Film yang berlatar di era Dinasti Song ini mengisahkan dua cerita tentang seberapa jauh seseorang akan berkorban demi cinta atau nafsu.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, seorang kepala perusahaan keamanan Iron Bodyguard, bertemu dengan seorang murid yang merupakan anggota Reformis, kelompok sarjana yang mendesak reformasi sosial di Tiongkok pada akhir dinasti Qing.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Kisah legendaris yang bercerita tentang keberanian dan kepahlawanan ini dibintangi oleh Ivy Ling Po yang berperan sebagai Mulan, gadis yang bergabung dengan tentara dan menjadi pahlawan sejati bagi warga Tiongkok.

programme.title: Pursuit Of Vengeance
programme.desc: Legenda Kung Fu Ti Lung membintangi film laga ini sebagai Fu Xue Hong, yang memulai perjalanan agar dapat membalas dendam untuk ayahnya.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Seorang wanita cantik nan bodoh diculik oleh alien, tapi tak ada yang mempercayainya. Saat berencana bunuh diri demi membuktikan dirinya, ia bertemu dengan seorang detektif gagal yang juga berencana untuk bunuh diri.

programme.title: The Tiger And The Widow
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung terlibat dalam sebuah jaringan penyelundupan orang-orang hilang dan berada dalam situasi yang membahayakan.

programme.title: The Tiger And The Widow
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung terlibat dalam sebuah jaringan penyelundupan orang-orang hilang dan berada dalam situasi yang membahayakan.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Dalam film kung fu klasik ini, Shih Zu, salah satu pahlawan wanita di perfilman laga Hong Kong, bekerjasama dengan Lo Lieh untuk menemukan dan melindungi segel kerajaan Dinasti Sung.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: 72 penghuni rumah petak nan kumuh hidup di bawah pengawasan pemilik rumah yang tak berperasaan dan suami jahatnya. Namun, kedatangan seorang penyewa baru nan berani, mengubah nasib mereka.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima bekerja untuk tuan Qin yang menderita penyakit mematikan dan hanya bisa disembuhkan oleh ramuan khusus. Qin mengirimnya dalam sebuah misi untuk mendapatkannya dan bertarung dengan senjata pamungkasnya, Rudal Naga!

programme.title: Whose Baby Is In Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, seorang guru laki-laki di SMA khusus perempuan, terjebak dengan bayi yang bukan miliknya dan harus merawatnya. Murid-murid kelasnya membantu mengurus bayi itu sementara ia menggunakan pesonanya pada Li Ching.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: Dalam film tentang perjudian ini, Danny Lee berperan sebagai seorang penjudi putus asa yang melakukan kecurangan saat berjudi di sebuah kasino di Makau. Ia pun harus menghadapi seorang pemimpin geng asal Jepang.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Mei Li muda bekerja sebagai pelayan bar di Wanchai untuk mencari nafkah. Ia jatuh cinta pada Jimmy saat bertemu dengannya di sana. Namun, Mei Li merasa sangat terpukul saat Jimmy harus pergi.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Pada awal tiga dekade, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, dan Pan Ying-tzu menampilkan superstar internasional Shaw yang pertama, Lo Lieh untuk Han Family Sword memberikan suguhan bintang empat untuk penggemar film laga ini.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: Kaisar Qianlong bukanlah penerus takhta yang sah sejak lahir, tetapi ia baru mengetahui kebenarannya saat dua anggota senior organisasi rahasia anti-pemerintah menghubunginya beberapa tahun kemudian.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao, murid dari ahli seni bela diri Shi. Suatu hari, ia secara tak sengaja menyelamatkan musuh tuannya, Jin, hingga ia mengajarinya seni bela diri nan unik sebagai balasannya. Namun, Master Shi mengira Gao berkhianat.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Peter Chen Ho adalah seorang playboy tampan yang mengencani tiga gadis kakak beradik, dan hal ini memicu serangkaian peristiwa konyol dan menghebohkan.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Tiga pendukung setia Sung bekerja sama untuk melawan para penjajah Tartar. Ma melepaskan putri dari penjajah Tartar yang diculik dalam sebuah upaya strategis untuk melawan para penjajah.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: Ibu Suri Cixi mempercayai pernyataan kelompok pemberontak penjajahan jika mereka kebal terhadap pisau dan senjata. Ia pun memutuskan untuk memanfaatkan mereka untuk mengusir penjajah asing dari Tiongkok.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: Bintang-bintang Shaw Brothers dan TVB bersatu untuk film epik karya Wang Feng ini. Masalah muncul ketika seorang gangster berencana untuk mengubah tempat favorit penduduk Gossip Street menjadi sebuah sarang perjudian.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping dan Su adalah sepasang kekasih yang mengelola agen perjalanan khusus liburan ke Asia Tenggara. Seorang kepala sekolah bernama Tung beserta murid-muridnya bergabung dalam tur yang dipimpin oleh Ping.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: Seorang Pendeta Taois tidak senang ketika rekan Pendeta Buddha-nya pindah ke sebelah rumahnya. Mereka sering terlibat perselisihan dan duel, tetapi segera harus mengatasi masalah mereka ketika seorang vampir keluar dari peti matinya dan mendatangkan malapetaka di pedesaan.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri miskin, Shui dan Ti, berusaha membangun kehidupan mereka sendiri. Dan melalui kerja keras mereka berdua, Shui menjadi seorang eksekutif pemasaran, kemudian sikapnya mulai berubah.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, yang pernah menjadi juara dunia tinju, melarikan diri ke Makau dari rentenir dan secara tak terduga bertemu Qi, seorang pemuda yang bertekad memenangkan pertandingan tinju.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Gangster kejam Guts melakukan perampokan berlian, lalu meminta bantuan anggota triad lama, Fei, untuk mengatur pembeli. Namun ketika Guts mengkhianati pembeli, Fei malah mendapatkan berlian tersebut, dan dicari oleh polisi serta Guts.

programme.title: God Of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: Cho yang multitalenta ingin belajar dari Dewa Judi dan menghubungi muridnya. Mereka diserang oleh seorang bos kriminal yang berencana menyalahgunakan nama baik Dewa Judi untuk menghasilkan jutaan.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Seorang badut secara tidak sengaja direkrut oleh seorang pemimpin sekte untuk memata-matai seorang kaisar Tiongkok yang muda dan tidak berpengalaman. Segalanya tidak berjalan sesuai rencana, dan dia akhirnya bekerja untuk beberapa pihak yang saling bertentangan sambil berusaha bertahan hidup di tengah kegilaan tersebut.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: Putra dari keluarga kaya jatuh cinta pada seorang wanita yang hanya akan menikahinya setelah ia menjadi seorang Guru Kung-Fu. Dalam 'Drama Komedi' ini, ia menjadi pahlawan legendaris dengan berusaha menyelamatkan kaisar, dalam pencarian cintanya yang sebenarnya.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Berlatar belakang tahun-tahun awal Republik Tiongkok, keluarga Kang yang kaya dibunuh secara brutal, dan putri kecil mereka satu-satunya saksi menghilang secara misterius.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: Kisah tentang pengalaman imigran ilegal dari Tiongkok daratan yang berhasil sampai ke Hong Kong untuk kehidupan yang lebih baik.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Lily, adalah seorang gadis biasa yang menjalani kehidupan sederhana. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah pasar antik, dia menemukan sepasang sepatu kaca berlian yang indah. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle mengisahkan seorang instruktur bela diri yang dipenjara setelah sebuah insiden fatal. Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh bergabung dengan Spinsters' Club yang riang ketika dia menemukan suaminya berselingkuh. Terlepas dari wajah bahagia yang ditampilkan oleh saudara perempuannya, di balik itu semua, masing-masing dari mereka diam-diam merindukan seorang pria dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Cinderella
programme.desc: Kelanjutan yang berbelit-belit dari petualangan Raja Kera yang kini menjadi manusia dan melakukan perjalanan waktu, yang berupaya memenuhi takdir ilahinya.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Arkeolog Jack terus mengalami mimpi berulang tentang kehidupan masa lalunya, di mana ia adalah Jenderal besar Meng Yi yang bersumpah melindungi seorang putri bernama Ok-Soo. Jack kemudian memutuskan untuk menyelidiki semua misteri tersebut bersama sahabatnya, William.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta menemukan bahwa pasokan air di desanya telah terkontaminasi oleh kelelawar, dan saat sedang menggali sumur untuk mencari sumber air baru, ia tanpa sengaja menemukan mayat seorang pendeta Barat yang jahat.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: Seorang detektif membantu temannya menyelidiki kematian misterius ayah mertuanya.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi dan PI Lam mencuri dua plat USD100 yang dicuri di Hong Kong. Lam kehilangan mereka - tidak ada hadiah dari AS. Lam dan ketiga malaikat kecilnya mencoba mendapatkannya kembali di Seoul, begitu pula JJ. Banyak pertarungan.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: Sebelum memenangkan pujian dalam film laga berkat aksi-aksi mereka yang berani, para bintang ini menjalani tahun-tahun penuh darah, keringat, dan air mata saat berlatih di bawah bimbingan Master Yu yang kejam.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Satpam Lee Go ditugaskan untuk menjaga sebuah rumah saat pemiliknya pergi. Namun, serangkaian kesalahpahaman lucu terjadi.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man menerima sebuah tantangan bertarung dari master asal utara yang sudah tua bernama Gong Yu Tian dan berhasil memenangkannya. Namun, ia dikalahkan oleh putri sang master, Gong Er, dan jatuh cinta padanya.

Dalam perjalanan mencari ketenangan dan awal baru, ia bertemu kembali dengan seseorang dari masa lalunya yang membangkitkan kenangan serta perasaan lama. Di tengah suasana alam yang menenangkan, keduanya perlahan menyembuhkan luka masa lalu dan mempertanyakan apakah hubungan mereka masih memiliki kesempatan untuk berkembang.

programme.title: The Assault

programme.title: Bulatkan Tekad Uji Nyali Mengejar Cintamu
programme.desc: Irene mendapatkan sebuah hadiah liburan dengan syarat harus membawa pasangan. Namun, masalah yang dihadapi Yoga dan Irene bukan hanya diteror hantu, tapi ternyata mereka pun diteror pasangan mereka yang cemburuan.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Perjalanan Patah Hati
programme.desc: ada seorang gadis cantik bernama Mila yang disukai oleh beberapa orang pria tapi wanita muda tersebut menolaknya. Mila membuat patah hati para pria karena ia memilih untuk berpacaran dengan Arga, pria populer di sekolahnya. Beberapa tahun kemudian, anak-anak SMA itu reuni di sebuah villa tua. Hadir di sana beberapa orang yang terkenal saat SMA. Mereka adalah Mila Arga Dona, dan beberapa orang lainnya. Awalnya perjalanan mereka menyenangkan.Namun masalah datang Ketika Mila ditemukan meninggal secara misterius meski dinyatakan meninggal akibat kecelakaan. Orang-orang yang berada di sana, menuduh Arga menjadi dalang di balik meninggalnya Mila tersebut.

programme.title: Rasa Yang Tertinggal Di Waktu Yang Salah
programme.desc: Naura (Shanice Margaretha), perawat magang yang sering ceroboh bertemu dengan Darren (Masaji Wijayanto), seorang dokter killer yang perfeksionis. Namun, siapa sangka di balik ketegasannya, Darren memiliki sisi lembut yang mampu menarik hati Naura. Sama seperti Naura, Darren pun diam-diam merasakan perasaan yang sama terhadap Naura.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Kukira Kau Rumah Kosong
programme.desc: Kedua orang pemuda tampan bernama Niko dan Adit. Dua orang pemuda tersebut yang merupakan mahasiswa, bekerja di bengkel motor dan pelayan restoran, tapi mereka berlagak menjadi orang kaya. Niko dan Adit menyukai dua gadis bernama Fifi dan Rara, tapi pada pria tersebut berpura-pura menjadi orang kaya agar gadis impian mereka jatuh cinta. Masalah menjadi rumit saat kedua pria itu mengetahui bahwa Jaya memiliki seorang putri bernama Karina.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Ketika Rela Tak Semudah Kata
programme.desc: Sambil menunggu panggilan kerja, Yudha yang tidak ingin ibunya tahu kalau ia telah kehilangan pekerjaannya, terpaksa menjadi pengamen. Meski demikian, Sheila terus menyemangatinya hingga Yudha merasa nyaman bersama Sheila. Di sisi lain, Yudha memiliki Siska, sahabat yang menyukai Yudha. Yudha pun dihadapkan dua pilihan antara Sheila dan Siska.

Dia bertemu Jaka (yang pindah ke Bontang untuk urus resort oma Lisa dan deket pacarnya Erin) saat koper Jaka menyakitkan kakinya, mulai perselisihan. Setelah Zahra telat membuat client batal, Bima marah, sedangkan mamanya Widia minta dia putus. Amanda (sahabat Zahra) yang akan menikah minta Zahra cari resort, ternyata Jaka juga menawari resort oma. Mereka terpaksa kerjasama dengan syarat Jaka ikut semua urusan, hingga terjebak di laut dan Jaka mulai melihat kebaikan Zahra. Erin dan Bima ternyata selingkuh dan rencanakan merusak Jaka.

programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)

programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu

Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu (RCTI)

Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

channel.display-name: In The Heat Of The Night

programme.title: Tropical Heat
programme.desc: Junior officer Amelia Albers (guest star Shiri Appleby) is arrested for DUI while on leave in New York City, but her ripped clothes and injuries lead the police to call Detective Benson (Mariska Hargitay) for help. When a group of soldiers from her unit are named as suspects in her rape, Amelia refuses to cooperate with the SVU for fear of damage to her reputation in the military. When her commanding officer (guest star Terry Serpico) also hinders the investigation, Detective Amaro (Danny Pino) asks his ex-wife (guest star Laura Benanti) to dig up information on the case, and learns the grim reality that every female officer faces.

When her commanding officer (guest star Terry Serpico) also hinders the investigation, Detective Amaro (Danny Pino) asks his ex-wife (guest star Laura Benanti) to dig up information on the case, and learns the grim reality that every female officer faces.

When a group of soldiers from her unit are named as suspects in her rape, Amelia refuses to cooperate with the SVU for fear of damage to her reputation in the military. When her commanding officer (guest star Terry Serpico) also hinders the investigation, Detective Amaro (Danny Pino) asks his ex-wife (guest star Laura Benanti) to dig up information on the case, and learns the grim reality that every female officer faces.

programme.title: The Scorpion King: Book of Souls
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: Maquia: When The Promised Flower Blooms [English-Language Version]
programme.desc: "17-year-old run-away Yui and 8-year-old Hiyori, who lost her family and her voice, have no place to go when they run into Kiwa, a strange old lady. She offers them a place to stay, in a slightly banged-up old house overlooking the sea, a Mayoiga. Despite joining Kiwa on a whim, the two girls find comfort in Mayoiga, a legendary house, said to look after lost travelers, and the warm hospitality of Kiwa. Both girls' damaged hearts begin to heal little by little.

Despite joining Kiwa on a whim, the two girls find comfort in Mayoiga, a legendary house, said to look after lost travelers, and the warm hospitality of Kiwa. Both girls' damaged hearts begin to heal little by little.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
programme.desc: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park.

programme.title: Heretic

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
programme.desc: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Taboo
programme.desc: An unknown killer stalks six friends one year after they played a provocative parlor game.

programme.title: Bitch Slap
programme.desc: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Unlikely Angel
programme.desc: A dead country singer (Dolly Parton) seeks to get into heaven by uniting a troubled family during the holidays.

programme.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
programme.desc: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: F/X
programme.desc: Rollie Tyler (Bryan Brown) is a special-effects expert for low-budget Hollywood movies. As gangster Nicholas DeFranco (Jerry Orbach) prepares to testify in court against his former bosses, FBI agents, fearing Nicholas will be killed by the mob before he can take the stand, decide to fake his assassination. The agents hire Rollie to use his special-effects skills to make the murder look believable. Leo McCarthy (Brian Dennehy), a detective, steps in to investigate the murder.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Horns
programme.desc: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

programme.title: Evil Toons
programme.desc: Four sorority sisters get more than they bargained for when they agree to renovate a haunted mansion.

programme.title: Dark Ride

He escapes from the mental institution and returns to his old haunt, an amusement park with an attraction called "Dark Ride." Meanwhile, six friends on a road trip board the ride, not knowing of the deadly plans Jonah has in store.

However, when Francis starts to sleepwalk and experience night terrors, the couple soon discover they're being haunted by a ghost that wants to punish them for their sins.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Paradox Effect
programme.desc: estranged from her daughter because of a past life of drug-abuse, Karina is taking all the steps she can towards being the mother she needs to be. One night Karina hears the discharge of a muted weapon and a body breaking through heavy glass. Looking up, she locks eyes with the man who pulled the trigger and she is captured. The mastermind of it all is crime lord Silvio and his vicious gangsters who forces Karina and Covek, a deadly killer threatened by him, to go on a journey against time.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Concrete Canyons
programme.desc: In this thrilling crime drama, a sheriff searches for his son who is accused of murder and on the run from the law.

programme.title: From Embers
programme.desc: After the tragic loss of her husband Ron, Lily finds herself navigating a challenging new reality with her son Kevin. As they settle into a modest apartment, Lily's encounter with their neighbor Marty brings up an unexpected revelation about Ron's suspicious death. Marty is an alcoholic and his passion for music is only surpassed by his love for his daughter Chloe. When Lily delves deeper into the mystery surrounding Ron's demise, she forms a bond with his co-worker Angela.

programme.title: Great White Summer
programme.desc: From the peaks of Cape Cod's surfing waves to the murky depths below, trouble runs deep on this beloved New England seashore after the first fatal shark attack in eighty years upends the community. With the predator population on the rise, and increasing encounters placing lives and livelihoods in peril, Great White Summer chronicles a season of struggle as people demand action, priorities are questioned, personal allegiances shift, and growing suspicion clouds the waters.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Blunt Force Trauma
programme.desc: In the seedy underground dueling culture of South America, two opponents wearing Kevlar vests face each other, draw and shoot. With Mickey Rourke.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: The Heart of Me
programme.desc: A woman (Helena Bonham Carter) has an affair with her older sister's (Olivia Williams) husband (Paul Bettany) and bears his child.

programme.title: The Ticket
programme.desc: After James, a blind man, inexplicably regains his vision, he becomes possessed by a drive to make a better life for himself. However, his new improvements -- a nicer home, a higher paying job, tailored suits, luxury car -- leave little room for the people who were part of his old, simpler life. As his relationships buckle under the strain of his snowballing ambition, it becomes uncertain if James can ever return from darkness.

programme.title: Good Fences
programme.desc: A black attorney (Danny Glover), his wife (Whoopi Goldberg) and their two children move to a posh neighborhood in Greenwich, Conn.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: On a luxurious cruise on the Nile River, a wealthy heiress, Linnet Ridgeway (Lois Chiles), is murdered. Fortunately, among the passengers are famed Belgian detective Hercule Poirot (Peter Ustinov) and his trusted companion, Colonel Race (David Niven), who immediately begin their investigation. But just as Poirot identifies a motley collection of would-be murderers, several of the suspects also meet their demise, which only deepens the mystery of the killer's identity.

programme.title: The Killer Meteors
programme.desc: A powerful man seeks help from a local hero (Jackie Chan) whose secret weapon makes him invincible.

Troubled Italian filmmaker Guido Anselmi (Marcello Mastroianni) struggles with creative stasis as he attempts to get a new movie off the ground. Overwhelmed by his work and personal life, the director retreats into his thoughts, which often focus on his loves, both past and present, and frequently wander into fantastical territory. As he tries to sort out his many entanglements, romantic and otherwise, Anselmi finds his production becoming more and more autobiographical.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

programme.title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: The Boys From Brazil
programme.desc: Dr. Josef Mengele (Gregory Peck) clones Hitler 95 times, and hopes to raise the resulting boys in Brazil, giving them childhoods identical to Hitler's. His ultimate plan is to create a band of Nazi leaders that can continue where Hitler left off, forming the Fourth Reich. Ezra Lieberman (Laurence Olivier), a Nazi hunter, learns of the plan and is determined to thwart it. When the two meet face-to-face in the home of one of the Hitler clones, it is up to the boy to choose who he will assist.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: Murder Legendre is the menacingly named zombie master of Haiti. Charles Beaumont goes to him when he needs help for a twisted plan. Spurned in marriage by Madeline Short, Beaumont has decided on a simple solution: kill Short and bring her back as a zombie. Then he can be with her forever. The only problem comes when Legendre keeps the fetching girl for himself -- and her new husband comes to Madeline's rescue.

programme.title: Take Me to the River
programme.desc: Music legends from Stax Records and Memphis mentor and pass on their musical knowledge to contemporary artists.

programme.title: Sharkansas Women's Prison Massacre
programme.desc: Five escaped prisoners (Dominique Swain, Cindy Lucas) use their guns and wits to battle prehistoric sharks that attack on land.

programme.title: City Hunter
programme.desc: U.S. criminals hijack a cruise ship with a gluttonous private eye (Jackie Chan) aboard who is seeking a magnate's missing daughter.

programme.title: Affliction
programme.desc: In a small New Hampshire town, washed-up cop Wade Whitehouse (Nick Nolte) has a troubled past, an abusive father (James Coburn), the contempt of his ex-wife (Mary Beth Hurt) and an unimpressive streak as a lawman. When hunting guide Jack Hewitt (Jim True) reports a businessman's accidental death during a hunting trip, Wade believes he has a chance to turn around his life, if he can prove it was murder. Increasingly obsessed, Wade begins to lose his composure during the investigation.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp
programme.desc: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Silent House
programme.desc: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

programme.title: House
programme.desc: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion. With six of her closest friends in tow, including the musically inclined Melody (Eriko Tanaka) and the geeky Prof (Ai Matsubara), Gorgeous arrives at the estate, where supernatural events occur almost immediately. A severed head takes flight, household appliances come to life and a portrait of a cat seems to contain an evil spirit.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Dog Soldiers
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

programme.title: Funny Games
programme.desc: An idyllic lakeside vacation home is terrorized by Paul (Arno Frisch) and Peter (Frank Giering), a pair of deeply disturbed young men. When the fearful Anna (Susanne Lothar) is home alone, the two men drop by for a visit that quickly turns violent and terrifying. Husband Georg (Ulrich Mühe) comes to her rescue, but Paul and Peter take the family hostage and subject them to nightmarish abuse and humiliation. From time to time, Paul talks to the film's audience, making it complicit in the horror.

programme.title: Night of the Demons
programme.desc: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Operation Red Sea
programme.desc: A commando force from the Chinese navy intercepts terrorists and rescues Chinese citizens in Yemen.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Accused of murder, a martial artist goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origins and the unknown enemies out to destroy him.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman looks for revenge after being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman's family.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt group of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself as a kung fu master.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: Martial-arts master Ip Man takes on a crooked developer and his gang of brutal thugs.

programme.title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
programme.desc: Ip Man and his son encounter racial discrimination after traveling to the United States to seek a better life.

programme.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
programme.desc: Defeated by Master Ip, martial arts expert Cheung Tin Chi tries to lead a normal life in Hong Kong until triad leaders draw him back into fighting.

programme.desc: The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun.

programme.title: Ip Man 2

programme.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
programme.desc: Defeated by Master Ip, martial arts expert Cheung Tin Chi tries to lead a normal life in Hong Kong until triad leaders draw him back into fighting.

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: A man (Gong Yoo), his estranged daughter and other passengers become trapped on a speeding train during a zombie outbreak in South Korea.

programme.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Filmmakers showcase the dedication and struggles of kung fu stuntmen and action directors working in Hong Kong cinema during the 1960s-'80s.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: When a teenage gamer accidentally opens a portal into her favorite side-scroller, she becomes trapped in a notorious intergalactic prison, home to the galaxy's most dangerous villains. To escape, she must finish the game with a little help from her not-so-savvy friend on the outside -- or remain a 16-bit character forever.

programme.title: Enter the Fat Dragon
programme.desc: A police officer investigates the mysterious death of a suspect who was in his custody during a routine transfer.

programme.title: A Janitor
programme.desc: Fukumi is a high school janitor whose father was a gangster. He works at the school as a janitor instead of belonging to the gang so he can watch out for Yui, the daughter of his deceased father's brother Majima Yoshiki.

programme.title: Train to Busan

programme.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen

programme.title: Enter the Fat Dragon
programme.desc: A police officer investigates the mysterious death of a suspect who was in his custody during a routine transfer.

programme.title: A Janitor
programme.desc: Fukumi is a high school janitor whose father was a gangster. He works at the school as a janitor instead of belonging to the gang so he can watch out for Yui, the daughter of his deceased father's brother Majima Yoshiki.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Two high school girls who are about to graduate also happen to be highly-skilled assassins. When the organization that employs them orders them to share a room, their relationship turns sour.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahiro must pay four years of overdue fees or lose their membership in their assassin guild. They take part-time jobs, but find themselves in the middle of an armed robbery and being hunted by other assassins.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: The Scorpion King: Book of Souls
programme.desc: Two fierce warriors search for the powerful Book of Souls to fight an evil warlord.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Children of Men
programme.desc: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction and the last child born has perished, a disillusioned bureaucrat (Clive Owen) becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population; He must face down his own demons and protect the planet's last remaining hope from danger.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: Unfriended
programme.desc: One night, while teenagers Blaire, Mitch, Jess, Adam Ken and Val take part in an online group chat session, they are suddenly joined by a user known only as "Billie227." Thinking it's just a technical glitch, the friends carry on their conversation... until Blaire begins receiving messages from someone claiming to be Laura Barns, a classmate who killed herself exactly one year prior. As Blaire tries to expose Billie's identity, her friends are forced to confront their darkest secrets and lies.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: Hawthorne College is quieting down for the holidays as students travel home to spend time with their families. But as Riley and her sorority sisters prepare to deck the halls with seasonal parties, a mysterious cloaked figure starts to leave a bloody trail throughout the campus. Refusing to become hapless victims, Riley and her friends decide to band together and fight back against the psychotic Christmas killer.

programme.title: Nocturnal Animals
programme.desc: A successful Los Angeles art-gallery owner's idyllic life is marred by the constant traveling of her handsome second husband. While he is away, she is shaken by the arrival of a manuscript written by her first husband, who she has not seen in years. The manuscript tells the story of a teacher who finds a trip with his family turning into a nightmare. As Susan reads the book, it forces her to examine her past and confront some dark truths.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Slither
programme.desc: Wheelsy is a small town where not much happens and everyone minds his own business. No one notices when evil slips in quietly but when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

programme.title: Devil
programme.desc: Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: Becca and younger brother Tyler say goodbye to their mother as they board a train and head deep into Pennsylvania farm country to meet their maternal grandparents for the first time. Welcomed by Nana and Pop Pop, all seems well until the siblings start to notice increasingly strange behavior from the seemingly charming couple. Once the children discover a shocking secret, they begin to wonder if they'll ever make it home.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: Bangkok Dangerous
programme.desc: Remorseless assassin Joe (Nicolas Cage) is in Thailand to complete a series of contract killings for a crime boss called Surat (Nirattisai Kaljaruek). He hires a street punk named Kong (Shahkrit Yamnam) to run errands for him, all the while planning to kill the youth at the conclusion of his assignment. Instead, Joe becomes Kong's unlikely mentor, and begins a tentative romance with a local shop girl. But as Joe begins to let his guard down, Surat decides it is time to clean house.

programme.title: Bad Moms
programme.desc: Amy (Mila Kunis) has a great husband, overachieving children, beautiful home and successful career. Unfortunately, she's also overworked, exhausted and ready to snap. Fed up, she joins forces with two other stressed-out mothers (Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn) to get away from daily life and conventional responsibilities. As the gals go wild with their newfound freedom, they set themselves up for the ultimate showdown with PTA queen bee Gwendolyn and her clique of seemingly perfect moms.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: An ordinary woman who struggles with feelings of insecurity and inadequacy on a daily basis wakes from a fall believing she is suddenly the most beautiful and capable woman on the planet. With this newfound confidence, she is empowered to live her life fearlessly and flawlessly, but what will happen when she realizes her appearance never changed?

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook
programme.desc: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange.

programme.desc: From the director of Ride Along and Barbershop and the co-writer of Girls Trip. We can't all die first.

programme.title: The House Next Door: Meet the Blacks 2
programme.desc: After surviving a night of terror on the West Coast, author Carl Black moves his family back to his childhood home in Chicago. His quest to find peace and quiet takes an unexpected turn when he meets the eccentric new homeowner next door. Convinced that the man is a vampire, Carl and his oddball neighbors join forces to save themselves from the bloodsucking undead.

programme.title: American Psycho
programme.desc: In New York City in 1987, a handsome, young urban professional, Patrick Bateman (Christian Bale), lives a second life as a gruesome serial killer by night. The cast is filled by the detective (Willem Dafoe), the fiancé (Reese Witherspoon), the mistress (Samantha Mathis), the coworker (Jared Leto), and the secretary (Chloë Sevigny). This is a biting, wry comedy examining the elements that make a man a monster.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.
